<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex2702_2024-09-1114-42-582" status="unreviewed" ana="corpusmd:colophon">
ye shes chen po'i snang ba rgyas shing yon tan pad mo'i dpal bskyed de || rnam grol mchog gi dga' ba'i tshal du zag med bde la spyod gyur cig |
<rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4661"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3749">theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos</rs> kyi rnam par bshad pa nges don rab gsal snang ba</rs> zhes bya ba || 
bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin la brten nas || 
rig pa'i gnas lnga la blo gros kyi snang ba cung zad thob pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4128">bod kyi paN+Di ta 'jam dbyangs blo gros</rs> kyis <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5733">dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po</rs>r nye bar<anchor xml:id="a8"/> sbyar ba'o ||   
   bstan pa rin po che dang 'gro ba mang po la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig  || | 
   
   mang+ga laM b+ha wa tu|          
   yi ge pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6834">seng ge</rs> yi ming can nga'o || </seg></TEI>
